newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Nov 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi contracting sector to grow 10 percent in the next few years, experts say.
- New industrial and investment opportunities worth 1.8 billion riyals in Saudi Arabia's eastern province, officials say.
- Soda project built at a cost of 111 million riyals will start production in 1997 in Jubail.
- Saudi trade with Russia in 1995 was worth 839 million riyals.
- Crown Prince Abdullah to inaugurate new projects worth nine billion riyals in Rabigh on the Red Sea next month.
- Islamic Development Bank financed 180 projects worth $1.637 billion in 1995, chairman says.
